T: Four voices. One stage. A lot of soul.
D: In 1968, four young Aboriginal women from a country mission form a soul group and tour Vietnam to sing for the troops.
P: Serve the mains when the Sapphires hit the stage for the troops in Vietnam.
S: the talent quest at the country pub where it starts
Hot party pies and sausage rolls straight from the oven, with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle, the way any country pub serves them.
Small baguettes with pork pâté, roast pork, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli.
home on the mission before the tour
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, served warm with butter and golden syrup.
M: Beef bones simmered 6 hours with charred onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon and clove, seasoned with fish sauce, over rice noodles with raw beef slices, herbs, bean sprouts and lime.
Sunday at the troops' mess hall
Beef topside seasoned and roasted at 200C to 52C, rested and carved thin, with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and a gravy made in the roasting tin with flour and stock.
W: a taste of home for the Aussies abroad
Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, set on a rack.
K: a hot, humid night in Saigon
Strong dark coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice.

s.note: the talent quest at the country pub where it starts
s.how: Heat 12 frozen party pies as the packet says. Roll 400g sausage mince in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

s.note: home on the mission before the tour
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and salt. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until just combined. Shape, score and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: Sunday at the troops' mess hall
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin. Cook 300g peas. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the roasting tin, add 400ml stock and simmer into gravy.

w.note: a taste of home for the Aussies abroad
w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.

d.note: a hot, humid night in Saigon
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.
